verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents that it will calculate, file, and pay federal and state payroll taxes for the user. It backs this with a 100% accuracy guarantee and up to $25,000 in tax penalty protection, and a higher tier has experts file payroll taxes. Local payroll taxes, which the story explicitly names, are never mentioned. missing for 10: evidence of local tax calculation, filing, and remittance; independent or hands-on corroboration of automated filing and remittance.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have federal, state, and local payroll taxes calculated, filed, and remitted automatically

citations.quote: We’ll calculate, file, and pay your federal and state payroll taxes for you—100% accurate tax calculations guaranteed.
With tax penalty protection we'll pay up to $25,000 if you receive a penalty.
Experts run payroll and file payroll taxes
